## What does this change do?

Describe the problem and the intended behavior.

## How was it tested?

- [ ] Python compilation
- [ ] Relevant unit tests
- [ ] PostgreSQL behavior tested (if database code changed)
- [ ] Telegram behavior tested with a separate test bot (if handlers changed)

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No tokens, passwords, database URLs, user data, or production backups included
- [ ] No unrelated files or generated artifacts included
- [ ] Existing behavior is preserved unless the change intentionally changes it
- [ ] Database/schema and migration implications are documented
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed
